gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-pridi: Bent-paperclip lettering, loosely spaced and friendly. Nasalization earns its keep large and short, while Pridi lets its small letters stand proud, almost capital-sized, with generous space around the curves.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-scope-one: Floating, friendly letters with short ascenders and a c opened wide like calipers. But Nasalization stays smooth and swell-free, while Scope One lets its counters spill out beside a big x-height.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-slabo-13px: A soft, featureless hum of floating letters. Nasalization hums like a quiet machine over Slabo 13px, whose bookish, dignified serif has large, open counters and clear openings in rounded letters.
gen-dafont-neon-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, leaving generous space between its curve ends and the stems. Neon brings the glow, with tall stamped-metal lowercase in unbroken lines, spaced openly.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-noticia-text: Glowing, flat-weight letters, tall as stamped metal. Noticia Text adds a literary, dignified serif whose curves have big visible entrances, while Neon glows beside it in flat, unvarying lines.
gen-dafont-neon-gf-suwannaphum: Neon draws every letter in one unbroken, unvarying, glowing line. Suwannaphum adds a paperclip-open c and a high, squared-off x-height, and its dignified editorial manner grounds all that glow.
gen-dafont-neon-instrument-sans: Neon glows through tall, stamped-metal lowercase in unbroken lines. Instrument Sans keeps a constant stroke and pincer-like c ends, leaving Neon to earn its keep big and in short bursts.
gen-dafont-neon-mulish: Neon glows in tall, unbroken lines with open spacing. Mulish takes the quieter job, with horseshoe-magnet apertures, no stroke modulation at all, and short ascenders beside a large x-height.
gen-dafont-neuropol-fs-merriweather-sans: Bent-pipe lettering, constant in width, with a slim channel where the c opens. Merriweather Sans brings tall, sturdy lowercase and a clear-eyed e, so Neuropol is best saved for larger sizes.
gen-dafont-neuropol-manrope: Single-weight outline lettering with a slim channel in the c. Manrope fills in with bright open mouths on every curve and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, giving Neuropol an approachable partner.
